raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":476,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT ROUND(((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) / r.revenue, 2) AS tax_to_revenue_ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰控股' AND r.tax_year = 2025;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"计算顺丰控股2025年度所得税额占营业收入的比例","tables":["MYSQL:finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns","MYSQL:finance_tax.stocks","MYSQL:finance_tax.companies"],"columns":["revenue","non_taxable_income","deductions","prior_year_losses","employee_count","total_assets","is_restricted_industry","tax_year","company_id","stock_name","is_key_high_tech"]}],"assumptions":["所得税额按应纳税所得额乘以适用税率计算，税率根据高新技术企业资格及小型微利企业条件确定，与训练案例口径一致","营业收入使用企业所得税年度申报表中的收入总额（revenue）字段"]}
